about: Contract-label fixtures, run by tools/ci/test-hygiene.ps1 against docs/ownership.json. frozen: the freeze tag (contracts-v1) exists. changelogAdded: the lines the PR adds to docs/contracts/CHANGELOG.md. 'labels' absent means the labels are unknown.

cases.name: before-freeze
cases.why: positive control: before contracts-v1, contract texts change without the label

cases.name: frozen-text-without-label
cases.why: after contracts-v1, a contract text changes only in a contract-change PR
match: ^contract files changed after contracts-v1 without the 'contract-change' label: docs/contracts/lrm-core\.md$

cases.name: frozen-code-without-label
cases.why: contract code counts too: Lrm.Core, Gpu.Core with its generated files, Shaders include files

cases.name: frozen-tolerances-without-label
cases.why: tolerances.json and Cluster Protocol*.fs are contract files

cases.name: frozen-non-contract
cases.why: positive control: kernels, cluster internals and the contract index are not contract files

cases.name: label-without-changelog
cases.why: a contract-change PR needs a CHANGELOG entry
match: ^a 'contract-change' PR needs an entry in docs/contracts/CHANGELOG\.md

cases.name: changelog-misses-a-text
cases.why: every contract text the PR touches is named in the added CHANGELOG lines
changelogAdded: - **LrmCore v2** (`lrm-core.md`, S1): DType code 9 = U16. Vectors: C2 gains a U16 row.
match: ^docs/contracts/CHANGELOG\.md: no added line names execution-class\.md, which this PR changes$

cases.name: complete-contract-change
cases.why: positive control: label, contract change and a CHANGELOG entry naming it
changelogAdded: - **LrmCore v2** (`lrm-core.md`, S1): DType code 9 = U16. Vectors: C2 gains a U16 row.

cases.name: label-without-contract-change
cases.why: the label marks contract changes only
match: ^the 'contract-change' label is set, but no contract file changed; remove the label$

cases.name: labels-unknown
cases.why: outside a PR the label rule is reported as a warning, not enforced
warn: ^PR labels are unknown \(not a pull request\), so the 'contract-change' label was not checked for: docs/contracts/lrm-core\.md$
